I like this game so far... I wanted to wait longer before giving it a review but with the latest patch I have to point something out. My No is based simply on this because it ruined the game for me and my friend. It's just me and my friend that play, aka two, it worked well until now... The spawn rate is too high for two players. And this is not a difficulty complaint. I managed to do the quests. But it's simply not fun when the gameplay now is hide in a house, wait 2 - 3 minutes, go to the next house, wait 2 - 3 minutes (No clue how you do quests outside of village tbh, not that I tried) Rinse and repeat.. I assume this patch just did a flat spawn rate increase instead of adjusting for player count (which probably was great for groups of 4 or more) but horrible for me and my friend. I sincerely hope devs look into this because I I want to change my review to positive asap because the game is honestly great outside of that but for 2 players I can't recommend the game which is what I play most of my games with.

This game was quite enjoyable for my friend and I, it's classic Lethal Company type game but instead of gathering quota you do quests. I like the ambience, the sound, the chilling darkness. The stalkers with knives are by far the best enemy, we had to look around for them, had some funny moments of them coming at worst times. The weeping angels are not particularly fun, they're often used in horror games, but it changes the feel of the game. It's like coilheads in Lethal Company, nearly everyone hates them, and these angels aren't even hard to deal with generally, you just have to stare and wait which is a drag, and sometimes they'll hit you by surprise a few times when you're going through an open area and don't see them. No indicator of their approach besides you being hit. Hope the game gets improved in way that makes it fun to keep playing more and more, we had our fill in these 7 hours, for now. It does have potential.

Solo: Initially really fun, game mechanics are good, and after a certain point (Night 15-20) it just becomes not possible/enjoyable. Probably a good 'One-and-Done' kind of game with friends on a weekend until it loses its luster. Combining all monsters at night is not fun, it's just boring knowing you cannot avoid/manage/evade clustered enemies/entities. The angels combined with anything ends a run. Multiple angels (three or more spawned) are eye-rolling and game breaking - I watched one go through a Boolean Tool seizure attempting to navigate a pathing map upstairs only for it to instant-kill/instant teleport on top of me. If angels follow you to the gate, the run is over, if angels spawn in areas you can't evade from ... why? 30+ Solo runs and the merchant ever only sold one handcannon.... Spawning one angel - maximum two spawns in a night FAR away from one another preferable. Otherwise it's just pointless to leave the starting area. Story is almost engaging to push through to figure out what happened but by this point, you just search the internet and get rid of the game because having 12+ creatures coming after you in a constant pursuit style is a lazy garbage game mechanic. Whoever invented the constant pursuit mechanic needs to be evicted from their meat suit. This mechanic truly makes one turn away from an otherwise incredible game. Atmosphere is fantastic, exploration is wonderful, time spent exploring without enemy gangbang chases were immersive and left me wanting to explore more. Remove constant pursuit mechanic, implement breaking line of sight to prevent further pursuit for more fear-inducing/anxiety horror gameplay. Or just get mods *shrug*

Make it more about discovering secrets and more about the story, while the current structure is the cycle keeping the game moving.
